full_judgment: 2. The petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 215 of 1996 in the Court of Assistant Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka subsequently transferred to the Court of Assistant Judge, Nawabganj and re-numbered as Title Suit No. 127 of 1997 for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession against the defendant-opposite parties stating, inter alia, that the suit property being homestead property belong to Hanif Sarker, who transferred the same by a registered sale deed dated 12-2-1964 in favour of the mother of the plaintiffs and defendant Nos. 1-2. The defendant Nos. 1-2 were allowed to live in the said homestead as licensee or with permission. The mother of the plaintiffs gifted the suit property and delivered the possession of the same to the plaintiffs by an oral gift dated 17-9-92. The defendant Nos. 1-2 obtained permission from the plaintiffs to live therein as licensee as before. Thereafter the mother of the plaintiffs swore an affidavit before the Notary Public, Dhaka in respect of her earlier oral gift in favour of the plaintiffs. That other two brothers namely, Kabir and Humayun of the plaintiffs were the witness in the said affidavit and the plaintiffs are in possession of some portion of the suit land through their tenant. That the plaintiffs served a notice upon the defendants to vacate the suit premises but the defendants declined to do so, hence the instant suit.
